BF_URL_UNVERIFIED.label: the source could not be verified live
BF_URL_UNVERIFIED.explain: The source page could not be verified live when the backfill ran, so it could not be cited.

CS_MECHANISM_UNKNOWN.label: the incident's mechanism is undisclosed
CS_MECHANISM_UNKNOWN.explain: The root cause or technique has not been disclosed, so no control can be shown to have failed.

CS_NARROW.label: not widely deployed; idiosyncratic
CS_NARROW.explain: The affected product or control is not widely used in financial services: a niche product, one bespoke system or one firm’s misconfiguration.

CS_NOT_NEW.label: already established, including a published shift re-demonstrated by a different event; repeat failure
CS_NOT_NEW.explain: The shift was already public, or is already in the archive; a repeat of a known failure is not new.

CS_NO_ASSUMPTION.label: no relied-on assumption invalidated
CS_NO_ASSUMPTION.test: An assumption others rely on fails
CS_NO_ASSUMPTION.explain: The failure does not undo anything institutions commonly rely on.

CS_NO_SPECIFIC_CHANGE.label: nothing specific changed (including measurement-only evidence at launch)
CS_NO_SPECIFIC_CHANGE.explain: Nothing changed in what attackers can do or what controls withstand: a known technique used by a new group or against a new victim is not a shift.

CS_ROUTINE_VULN.label: vulnerability without an exception
CS_ROUTINE_VULN.explain: An exploited or newly disclosed vulnerability is routine on its own. It clears only with an exception: an attacker surviving the vendor’s full clean-up, a fix shown not to work, a compromised update channel, a flaw that defeats an identity control across customers, or a repeated or long pre-patch run in a remote-access, edge or email-security product.

CS_SPECULATIVE.label: evidence below grade
CS_SPECULATIVE.explain: The evidence is below the bar: a prediction, a lab result against a test system, or a claim without artefacts, rather than something observed or demonstrated against products in use.

EV_BELOW_FLOOR.label: no consequence limb met
EV_BELOW_FLOOR.explain: The consequence is below every floor, or its size was not confirmed: no outage, data loss, financial loss, penalty or confirmed campaign of the required scale.

EV_NO_PROMINENCE.label: prominence not met
EV_NO_PROMINENCE.explain: Not covered widely enough: it needs two independent outlets, at least one of them general or business press.

EV_NO_SECTOR_NEXUS.label: no sector nexus or transferability
EV_NO_SECTOR_NEXUS.explain: No link to financial services: the incident is outside the sector and its cause would not carry over to institutions.

GL_INSTITUTION_POSITION.label: value rests on one institution's position
GL_INSTITUTION_POSITION.explain: Its value rests on one institution’s own position, which the site never states.

GL_INSUFFICIENT_SUBSTANCE.label: too few facts to test any element
GL_INSUFFICIENT_SUBSTANCE.explain: Too few facts to test any part of the bar.

GL_NO_MECHANISM.label: a section passed but no mechanism guard holds
GL_NO_MECHANISM.test: A justified action for the reader
GL_NO_MECHANISM.explain: It passed a section, but no action (a question, an indicator or an awareness rationale) could be justified.

GL_PAYWALL_INSUFFICIENT.label: elements not establishable from headlines, leads and public sources
GL_PAYWALL_INSUFFICIENT.explain: Paywalled, and the public headline, lead and other sources do not carry enough facts to test it.

GL_RESEARCH_EXCLUDED.label: fails RA1–RA6
GL_RESEARCH_EXCLUDED.explain: Research that does not meet the evidence standard: no original data, no method open to scrutiny, or no disclosed sample.

GL_UNVERIFIABLE.label: leak site, anonymous, social or unnamed sourcing without confirmation, aggregator only, no original
GL_UNVERIFIABLE.explain: It rests on claims that cannot be confirmed: leak sites, anonymous or unnamed sources, or an aggregator with no original.

RT_EXEC_OWN_POSITION.label: statement about the speaker's own institution
RT_EXEC_OWN_POSITION.test: About the sector, not the speaker’s own firm
RT_EXEC_OWN_POSITION.explain: A bank executive speaking about their own institution rather than the sector.

RT_INSTRUMENT_INELIGIBLE.label: not an in-scope instrument or stage, including an eligible issuer's instrument R1 does not admit, and a formal instrument addressed to one firm (R1f)
RT_INSTRUMENT_INELIGIBLE.explain: Not a kind of document the section admits: a press release, report, work programme or note rather than a speech, consultation, supervisory direction or new rule.

RT_INSTRUMENT_NOT_NEW.label: formal rule or exam notice that is not new: a reminder, restatement, correction, extension or re-publication, or an instrument first issued in final form more than max_event_age_days before the run
RT_INSTRUMENT_NOT_NEW.explain: A rule or exam notice that is not new: a reminder, restatement, correction, extension or re-publication, or first issued too long ago.

RT_JURISDICTION.label: issuer outside the US, UK and EU, or a global standard setter while rt_standard_setters is none
RT_JURISDICTION.explain: The issuer is outside the US, UK and EU.

RT_NOT_SPECIFIC.label: no specific topic and behaviour; for a formal instrument, no specific technology-risk obligation or examination content (R4f)
RT_NOT_SPECIFIC.explain: No specific technology-risk topic with an expected behaviour or obligation.

RT_NO_DIRECTION.label: soft signals only: restatement, a published signal repeated, or no direction signalled
RT_NO_DIRECTION.explain: No change of direction: it restates an existing position, repeats a published signal, or asks questions without signalling intent.

RT_SPEAKER_INELIGIBLE.label: below tier, staff, former official, trade body, non-financial authority not admitted, non-qualifying bank or role
RT_SPEAKER_INELIGIBLE.explain: The speaker or issuer does not qualify: staff below the senior tier, a trade body, or an authority type the section does not admit.
